page.overview:
Who is Coriander Cumin and Saffron Masala?

Coriander Cumin and Saffron Masala are a father and daughter team of unicorn ponies who appear in the season six episode Spice Up Your Life. They own a restaurant in Canterlot called The Tasty Treat, which serves Indian-inspired cuisine.

Coriander Cumin shares his body style and eye color with Claude, Stinky Bottom, "Leadnail McColt", "Mint Condition", "Port Wine", S05E06 Unnamed Earth Stallion #21, and S06E03 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4. Saffron Masala was designed by Charmaine Verhagen and Kora Kosicka.

Coriander Cumin and Saffron Masala's names are references to Indian spices: coriander, cumin, saffron, and masala.

Coriander Cumin and Saffron Masala appear in Spice Up Your Life as the respective host and chef of a small restaurant called The Tasty Treat, which serves cuisine exotic to Canterlot.
